# Pinned @moosematrix/tokens 0.1.0 (app copy)

These files are a byte-identical copy of `packages/tokens/` at commit `d12b78d` (tokens 0.1.0).
`packages/tokens` moved to 0.1.1 (shared nav data, dark default, one theme writer). The app keeps
0.1.0 until its own migration PR, so a tokens release never changes the
live site. `tests/vendored-tokens.test.mjs` checks that these files match `SHA256SUMS`.

Do not edit by hand. Delete this folder in the PR that moves the app to 0.1.1.
